description: Merges multiple tickets into a target ticket in Zendesk. The source tickets are merged into the target ticket and then deleted. This is an asynchronous operation that returns a job status. Use when you need to consolidate duplicate or related tickets into a single ticket. **Important**: This action is irreversible - source tickets are permanently merged and deleted once the operation completes. Always verify the target_ticket_id and source_ticket_ids before executing.

inputSchema.description: Request model for merging tickets into a target ticket.

source_comment.description: Private comment to add to the source tickets before they are merged.
source_comment.human_parameter_description: An optional comment to add to the source tickets before they are merged.
source_comment.title: Source Comment

source_comment_is_public.description: Whether the comment added to source tickets is public or private. Defaults to false (private).
source_comment_is_public.human_parameter_description: Set to true for public comments or false for internal notes on source tickets.
source_comment_is_public.title: Source Comment Is Public

source_ticket_ids.description: Array of ticket IDs to merge into the target ticket. These tickets will be merged and then deleted.
source_ticket_ids.human_parameter_description: A list of ticket IDs to merge into the target ticket. All data from these tickets will be transferred to the target ticket.
source_ticket_ids.title: Source Ticket Ids

target_comment.description: Private comment to add to the target ticket after the merge.
target_comment.human_parameter_description: An optional comment to add to the target ticket after the merge.
target_comment.title: Target Comment

target_comment_is_public.description: Whether the comment added to the target ticket is public or private. Defaults to false (private).
target_comment_is_public.human_parameter_description: Set to true for public comments or false for internal notes on the target ticket.
target_comment_is_public.title: Target Comment Is Public

target_ticket_id.description: The ID of the target ticket to merge other tickets into. This ticket will be retained after the merge.
target_ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk ticket that will be the destination for the merge. All source tickets will be merged into this ticket.
target_ticket_id.title: Target Ticket Id

inputSchema.title: MergeZendeskTicketsRequest

name: merge_zendesk_tickets

MergeJobResult.description: Result object for a single merge task.

id.title: Id

progress.title: Progress

status.title: Status

success.title: Success

total.title: Total

url.title: Url
